profile.headline: Backend Software Engineer
profile.summary: Analytical, resourceful, well-rounded, and results-oriented. Double major in computer science and Spanish from the University of Michigan. Software Development Engineer at Expedia Group in Chicago

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Generated data analytics reports for customers with Python and Kibana by processing live company data and distributed to senior client decision-makers
• Collaborated alongside senior architects to implement an automated data migration process to improve error handling and data accessibility
• Gained experience handling and ensuring the protection of sensitive data in a healthcare setting

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
• Organized and analyzed company data in Salesforce and Workday using Python and SQL for cleaner report building
• Used technical writing and data management skills to generate a report on recommended company data management techniques which I presented to chief executive officers

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
• Proposed and implemented updates in development of the company’s website, using HTML
• Took yearly inventory of the company’s various types of equipment
